description: This Java source file defines an Android activity demonstrating multi-property animations using the ValueAnimator framework. It includes animated balls with properties like position, size, and transparency, showing how to coordinate complex animations.

classes.name: MultiPropertyAnimation
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating multi-property animations on shape objects within an Android app.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom View subclass that manages animated shape objects and creates complex animations involving position, size, and alpha properties.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up button click listener to start animation.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Builds the AnimatorSet with multiple ObjectAnimators for different shape properties.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates and adds a new animated shape (ball) to the view with random color.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws all animated shape objects onto the canvas each frame.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Invalidates the view to trigger redraw during animation updates.
